title: HanoiArtisanBridgeCrawlSchema
description: Authoritative machine-readable crawling schema for Google AI Studio and external crawlers feeding Hanoi Artisan Bridge database.

entities.description: Aggregated rating snapshots of local artisan workshops from external public platforms.

rating_id.description: System generated UUID v4 primary key. Can be omitted by crawler.

provider_id.description: Foreign key pointing to verified provider_profiles.provider_id.

source_platform.description: Exact platform where the rating was extracted. Note: Facebook is NOT an allowed source.

rating_value.description: Average rating score on the platform (e.g. 4.85).

rating_scale.description: Max rating scale of the platform.

total_reviews.description: Total count of reviews displayed on the platform.

source_url.description: Direct URL to provider page on the platform.

crawled_at.description: Timestamp when the crawling execution occurred.

is_latest.description: Flags whether this is the newest snapshot for provider and platform. Enforced by unique partial index.

validation_rules: rating_value must be between 0.0 and rating_scale
total_reviews must be an integer greater than or equal to 0
source_platform must strictly match one of the allowed enum values (Facebook is prohibited)
deduplication_rules: Unique constraint provider_ratings_one_latest_uq strictly enforces only ONE latest record (is_latest = true) per provider_id and source_platform.
Unique constraint provider_ratings_snapshot_uq enforces unique (provider_id, source_platform, crawled_at) for historical records.

entities.description: Individual public customer review records for a local artisan workshop.

review_id.description: System generated UUID v4 primary key. Can be omitted by crawler.

provider_id.description: Foreign key pointing to verified provider_profiles.provider_id.

external_review_id.description: Unique identifier from the source platform (used for deduplication).

rating_value.description: Individual review rating if provided by the reviewer.

author_display_name.description: Sanitized public username/alias. Must NOT contain PII (email, phone, address).

original_language.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (e.g. vi, en, fr, ja, ko).

cleaned_content.description: Sanitized review body text free of tracking scripts, html tags, and rando boilerplate.

published_at.description: When the review was posted on the platform.

crawled_at.description: When the crawler scraped this review.

validation_rules: cleaned_content must not be empty or whitespace only
author_display_name must be stripped of any phone numbers, email addresses, or national identity codes
original review content is strictly immutable and must not be altered during AI sentiment tagging
deduplication_rules: Unique constraint provider_reviews_dedup_idx on (provider_id, source_platform, external_review_id) when external_review_id is present.
Unique constraint provider_reviews_null_id_dedup_uq on (provider_id, source_platform, md5(cleaned_content), published_at) when external_review_id is null.

entities.description: AI Sentiment extraction and aspect tagging output for individual customer reviews.

analysis_id.description: System generated UUID v4 primary key.

sentiment.description: Overall sentiment classification of the review.

sentiment_score.description: Continuous sentiment polarity score from -1.000 to +1.000.

sentiment_tags.description: JSON array of aspect tags mentioned in the review.

aspect_sentiments.description: Key-value mapping of each detected aspect tag to Positive/Neutral/Negative.

confidence_score.description: Model confidence level for sentiment classification.

ai_model_version.description: Exact AI model name and version used (e.g. gemini-1.5-pro, hab-sentiment-v1).

validation_rules: sentiment_tags must be a valid JSON array of string tags
deduplication_rules: One-to-one relationship with provider_reviews. Each review has exactly one active analysis row.

provenance_requirements: Every crawl record MUST retain its original source_platform and source_url.
Ratings from separate platforms MUST NEVER be combined or aggregated into a single entry without origin traceability.
crawled_at must be an authentic UTC ISO 8601 timestamp representing the fetch execution time.

prohibited_actions: NEVER crawl Facebook reviews (not an authorized OTA/travel platform source).
NEVER synthesize, fabricate, or hallucinate missing review content or ratings.
NEVER overwrite original cleaned_content with AI-generated summaries.
NEVER store personal phone numbers, emails, or personal identification details.
NEVER write directly to the database without validation through the agreed schema.
